Name: FadeHeim's Lavril anime portrait
Author: FadeHeim
Description:
[left][size=4]This mod is specially made for modification novices. Now Lavirl's portrait will automatically switch to my portrait in the game. In addition, I modified some expressions, well, just to make it more interesting:).

As for the Void portrait in Lavirl's house, I can't switch it to my portrait together. This part needs to be replaced manually. The portrait is put in the mod (portrait). Put the portrait in this position[color=#00ff00] [NPC] Lavirl/[CC] Void/Companions/Void[/color], so that Viod will be replaced with my portrait. Finally, I wish you a good time.

This is the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10016]Lavirl[/url]﻿ module page.

The following is also my anime style portrait.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37247]East Scarp anime style seasonal portrait
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38101]﻿Rasmodia anime style portrait[/url][/size]﻿
